objective: Repair ONLY predecessor input-identity validation in existing prior_packet/read path. The exact producer Git blob 6196286539bd3e3688dc3bbcf322b15112b9ef5c accepts a wrong pointer hash, content changed without updating its packet hash, a different valid target with mismatched pointer hash, and wrong packet contract. All four were reproduced with the real pinned GitCliSnapshot in temporary Git repositories; two changed the sign of the synthetic original delta. Preserve the existing canonical packet hash convention (canon excluding packet_sha256), exact declared pointer-to-packet identity, existing packet/pointer contracts, current valid-input outputs and legitimate first-packet absence behavior. Reject corrupt predecessor inputs before use and expose the existing appropriate integrity-failure reason. Do not change predecessor selection, freshness/window semantics or numerical rules. If a safe parent failure route cannot be implemented without new market-policy semantics, STOP and return NEEDS_MORE_EVIDENCE for existing framework-owner adjudication.
